summary: 42-year-old Ian Schaul of Crested Butte carried 200-300 ft through trees in a soft-slab avalanche on Snodgrass Mountain, severe lower leg injury; 15-member CBSAR response with CareFlight 4 helicopter evacuation to Grand Junction.
notes: CBSAR paged 2:28 p.m. Tuesday 2020-12-15. D1.5 soft slab (~1 ft thick), NE aspect ~10,000 ft; Schaul skied with a partner, 911 call made from the position; CareFlight 4 out of Montrose landed on a flat bench ~300 ft above Gothic Road, 100-200 ft below the victim; airlifted ~2 hours after the call; rider's snowboard used as a makeshift rescue sled for the downslope transport. CBAC had reported 160+ natural and human-triggered avalanches over the preceding weekend. Merged CAIC classic 2020-21 season table row.
